subject: E-Commerce
title: Virtual Fitting Rooms
description: A short lesson to help you apply Virtual Fitting Rooms.

hook.text: Zara's virtual fitting room scans your body and shows how any garment fits you digitally. No changing room needed.

buildup.text: Fashion has the highest return rate in e-commerce: 30-40%. Size and fit are the top reasons for sending items back.

discovery.text: AI body scanning creates a digital avatar matching your exact measurements. Clothes are virtually draped on your body.

twist.text: Body scanning raises privacy concerns. Companies collecting 3D body data creates new categories of sensitive personal.

climax.text: Virtual fitting rooms could cut fashion returns in half. But they require sharing intimate body data with retailers.

punchline.text: 30-40% returns solved, 3D body data required. The fit problem trades privacy.

quiz.question: What is the main privacy concern with virtual fitting rooms?
options: They require detailed 3D body measurement data, creating sensitive personal information
